articles.title: How UK Fiscal Tightening Could Move Dunelm, Wickes And Halfords Shares
articles.summary: UK fiscal policy is tightening as inflation, tax debates and a £3tn debt pile reshape the rules of the game for smaller domestically focused stocks. That kind of pressure can shift capital quickly and leave slower investors watching from the sidelines. This article looks at three UK small caps that sit in the crosshairs of these changes and explains how the latest policy moves could help or hurt their share prices.
